arXiv:2603.20111v1 [cs.LG] 2026 年 3 月 20 日arXiv:2603.20111v1 [cs.LG] 20 Mar 2026

Var-JEPA：联合嵌入预测架构的变分公式——桥接预测和生成自监督学习Var-JEPA: A Variational Formulation of the Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture – Bridging Predictive and Generative Self-Supervised Learning

Moritz Gögl    Christopher Yau
摘要Abstract

联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）通常被视为基于可能性的自监督学习的非生成替代方案，强调表示空间中的预测而不是观察空间中的重建。我们认为，由此产生的与概率生成模型的分离在很大程度上是修辞性的，而不是结构性的：规范的 JEPA 设计——具有上下文到目标预测器的耦合编码器——镜像了当变分推理应用于特定类别的耦合潜变量模型时获得的变分后验和学习条件先验，而标准 JEPA 可以被视为一种确定性专业化，其中通过架构和训练启发式方法而不是显式似然性来实施正则化。基于这个观点，我们推导出变分 JEPA (Var-JEPA)，它通过优化单个证据下界 (ELBO) 使潜在生成结构变得明确。这无需特别的抗崩溃正则化器即可产生有意义的表示，并允许在潜在空间中进行有原则的不确定性量化。我们实例化表格数据框架 (Var-T-JEPA) 并实现强大的表示学习和下游性能，持续改进 T-JEPA，同时通过强大的原始特征基线保持竞争力。The Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) is often seen as a non-generative alternative to likelihood-based self-supervised learning, emphasizing prediction in representation space rather than reconstruction in observation space. We argue that the resulting separation from probabilistic generative modeling is largely rhetorical rather than structural: the canonical JEPA design–coupled encoders with a context-to-target predictor–mirrors the variational posteriors and learned conditional priors obtained when variational inference is applied to a particular class of coupled latent-variable models, and standard JEPA can be viewed as a deterministic specialization in which regularization is imposed via architectural and training heuristics rather than an explicit likelihood. Building on this view, we derive the Variational JEPA (Var-JEPA), which makes the latent generative structure explicit by optimizing a single Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO). This yields meaningful representations without ad-hoc anti-collapse regularizers and allows principled uncertainty quantification in the latent space. We instantiate the framework for tabular data (Var-T-JEPA) and achieve strong representation learning and downstream performance, consistently improving over T-JEPA while remaining competitive with strong raw-feature baselines.

1 简介Introduction

机器学习 (ML) 的主要目标是构建能够真正从数据理解和预测世界的模型。自监督学习方法通​​过训练模型来预测另一部分输入的一部分来解决这一挑战，从而无需人类标签即可学习丰富的表示。在此背景下，联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）被引入A main goal in machine learning (ML) is to build models that truly understand and predict the world from data. Self-supervised learning approaches address this challenge by training models to predict one part of an input from another, thereby allowing to learn rich representations without requiring human labels. In this context, the Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) was introduced byLeCun (2022）作为创建“世界模型”的一步，旨在学习世界的抽象表示以进行智能决策。与预测像素等原始输入的常规生成模型不同) as a step toward creating a “world model”, aiming to learn abstract representations of the world for intelligent decision-making. Unlike regular generative models that predict raw inputs such as pixels(van den Oord et al., 2016b, a; Parmar et al., 2018)，JEPA 背后的想法是通过预测目标视图的嵌入来完全在潜在空间中工作, the idea behind JEPA is to work entirely in the latent space by predicting the embedding of a target viewyy来自相关上下文信号的嵌入from the embedding of a related context signalxx.

这是使用上下文编码器实现的This is implemented using a context encoderfctxf^{\text{ctx}}，目标编码器, a target encoderftrgf^{\text{trg}}，和一个预测器, and a predictorgg。模型创建目标表示. The model creates a target representations^y\hat{s}_{y}从上下文表示from a context representationsxs_{x}和一个可选的辅助变量and an optional auxiliary variablezz，公式为：, formulated as:

sx=fctx​(x),sy=ftrg​(y),s^y=g​(sx,z).\displaystyle s_{x}=f_{\text{ctx}}(x),\quad s_{y}=f_{\text{trg}}(y),\quad\hat{s}_{y}=g(s_{x},z). (1)

训练目标最小化预测目标表示和实际目标表示之间的距离，The training objective minimizes the distance between the predicted and actual target representations,ℒJEPA=𝔼​[‖s^y−sg​(sy)‖22]\mathcal{L}_{\text{JEPA}}=\mathbb{E}\left[\|\hat{s}_{y}-\text{sg}(s_{y})\|_{2}^{2}\right], 其中, wheresg​(⋅)\text{sg}(\cdot)是停止梯度操作is a stop-gradient operation(Grill et al., 2020)。为了防止模型学习琐碎的预测特征，这种故意阻止梯度进入目标编码器至关重要。. This intentional blocking of gradients into the target encoder is crucial in order to prevent the model from learning trivial predictive features.

虽然功能强大，但这种设计有两个后果。首先，它很容易受到表征崩溃的影响，编码器学习输出恒定向量，从而最小化损失。这就需要临时解决方案，例如辅助成本While powerful, this design has two consequences. First, it is susceptible to representational collapse, where the encoders learn to output constant vectors, trivially minimizing the loss. This necessitates ad-hoc solutions, such as auxiliary costsC​(s^y)C(\hat{s}_{y}) (Drozdov et al., 2024; Balestriero and LeCun, 2025)或其他自定义正则化机制，例如指数移动平均线 (EMA)or other custom regularization mechanisms such as Exponential Moving Average (EMA)(Assran et al., 2023; Bardes et al., 2024; Thimonier et al., 2025)加强代表性多样性。其次，JEPA 通常被认为是基于可能性的自监督学习的一种根本上的非生成性替代方案，这表明与概率潜变量模型的分离to enforce representational diversity. Second, JEPA is typically framed as a fundamentally non-generative alternative to likelihood-based self-supervised learning, which suggests a separation from probabilistic latent-variable modeling(LeCun, 2022).

本文为这种分离提供了一个新颖的视角。我们认为这主要是修辞性的而不是结构性的：一般的 JEPA 设计包括耦合编码器和从上下文到目标的预测器，与耦合变分自动编码器 (VAE) 中的变分后验和学习条件先验紧密结合。This paper provides a novel perspective on this separation. We argue that it is mostly rhetorical rather than structural: the general JEPA design which includes coupled encoders and a predictor from context to target aligns closely with the variational posteriors and a learned conditional prior in a coupled variational autoencoder (VAE)(Kingma and Welling, 2013; Hao and Shafto, 2023)。具体来说，我们对一个概率模型进行逆向工程，该模型的 ELBO 产生 JEPA 预测器作为学习的潜在空间条件先验，并认为标准 JEPA 自然地被解释为确定性专业化，其中正则化是通过架构和训练启发式而不是显式可能性来强制执行的。虽然 JEPA 非生成框架的最初动机是为了避免对观察噪声进行建模，但当重构成为有用的正则化器时，我们的观点变得更加精确：它迫使潜在对象对预测信息进行编码，同时保留有原则的不确定性语义。这种新框架不仅将预测性和生成性自我监督联系起来，而且还提出了避免崩溃的内在途径，并实现了潜在空间不确定性的量化。. Concretely, we reverse-engineer a probabilistic model whose ELBO yields the JEPA predictor as a learned latent-space conditional prior, and argue that standard JEPA is naturally interpreted as a deterministic specialization in which regularization is enforced by architectural and training heuristics rather than an explicit likelihood. While the original motivation for JEPA’s non-generative framing was to avoid modeling observation noise, our view makes precise when reconstruction is a useful regularizer: it forces latents to encode predictive information while retaining a principled uncertainty semantics. This new framing not only connects predictive and generative self-supervision, but also suggests an inherent route to avoiding collapse and enables latent-space uncertainty quantification.

具体来说，我们的贡献是：（1）我们在 JEPA 和变分推理之间建立了一种新颖的形式联系，将其重新构建为确定性潜变量模型。 (2) 我们引入 Var-JEPA，这是一种源自此链接的生成式 JEPA，具有相应的 ELBO 目标。 (3) 我们展示了这个 ELBO 如何自然地防止表征崩溃，而不需要 JEPA 中常见的代理损失，并提供与 LeJEPA 中最近提出的 SIGReg 正则化的连接Specifically, our contributions are: (1) We establish a novel formal link between JEPA and variational inference, reframing it as a deterministic latent variable model. (2) We introduce Var-JEPA, a generative JEPA derived from this link, with a corresponding ELBO objective. (3) We show how this ELBO naturally prevents representational collapse without needing the surrogate losses common in JEPA and provide a connection to the recently proposed SIGReg regularization in LeJEPA(Balestriero and LeCun, 2025)。 (4) 我们为异构表格数据开发了实用的 Var-T-JEPA 实现。 (5) 我们在受控模拟研究和多个下游数据集中凭经验验证了我们的方法，显示出相对于标准 JEPA 的一致增益以及在原始特征上训练的强大基线。. (4) We develop a practical Var-T-JEPA implementation for heterogeneous tabular data. (5) We empirically validate our approach in a controlled simulation study and across multiple downstream datasets, showing consistent gains over standard JEPA and strong baselines trained on raw features.

2 相关工作Related Work

JEPA 风格的预测表示学习。JEPA-style predictive representation learning.

JEPA 被提议作为通过匹配表示来学习预测世界模型的通用框架JEPA was proposed as a general framework for learning predictive world models by matching representations(LeCun, 2022)。值得注意的实施包括 I-JEPA. Notable implementations include I-JEPA(Assran et al., 2023)，这表明这种方法可以通过预测上下文区域中的屏蔽区域的嵌入来学习强大的图像表示，而无需手工制作数据增强。 V-JEPA 扩展了视频方法，学习支持理解和预测的时空表示, which demonstrates that this approach allows to learn strong image representations without handcrafted data augmentations by predicting embeddings of masked regions from context regions. V-JEPA extends the approach to video, learning spatiotemporal representations that support understanding and prediction(Bardes et al., 2024)。 T-JEPA. T-JEPA(Thimonier et al., 2025)使 JEPA 适应异构表格数据的特征级屏蔽和转换器标记化，显示出有竞争力的表格表示学习，而无需严重依赖典型的数据增强。adapts JEPA to feature-level masking and transformer tokenization for heterogeneous tabular data, showing competitive tabular representation learning without the heavy reliance on typical data augmentations.

常见的 JEPA 实现使用 EMA 通过缓慢更新目标编码器来稳定训练Common JEPA implementations use EMA to stabilize training by slowly updating the target encoder(Assran et al., 2023; Bardes et al., 2024)，但是这种启发式方法并不直接控制学习嵌入的分布属性。相比之下，, but this heuristic approach does not directly control the distributional properties of the learned embeddings. 生成世界模型和潜在空间建模。Generative world models and latent-space modeling.

世界模型研究强调学习预测和规划的潜在动态World-model research has emphasized learning latent dynamics for prediction and planning(Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018)。与生成潜在模型和 VAE 相比. Compared to generative latent models and VAEs(Kingma and Welling, 2013; Bowman et al., 2016)，JEPA强调表示空间中的预测，并且经常避免显式似然建模。我们的主要贡献是证明类似 JEPA 的架构自然地产生于具有学习条件先验的变分潜变量模型。同时工作的同时, JEPA emphasizes prediction in representation space and often avoids explicit likelihood modeling. Our main contribution is to show that a JEPA-like architecture arises naturally from a variational latent-variable model with a learned conditional prior. While concurrent work byHuang (2026）还探索了用于不确定性感知潜在预测的 JEPA 概率公式，Var-JEPA 将 JEPA 公式化为具有统一 ELBO 的耦合潜在变量生成模型，从而在单个目标中桥接预测联合嵌入学习和生成建模。这表明 Var-JEPA 不是 JEPA 之上的增量正则化器，而是一个严格的变分公式，它暴露了预测器-编码器模式中隐含的潜在生成结构。) also explores a probabilistic formulation of JEPA for uncertainty-aware latent prediction, Var-JEPA instead formulates JEPA as a coupled latent-variable generative model with a unified ELBO, thereby bridging predictive joint-embedding learning and generative modeling in a single objective. This shows that Var-JEPA is not an incremental regularizer over JEPA, but a rigorous variational formulation that exposes the latent generative structure implicit in the predictor-encoder pattern.

3 JEPA 的变分视角The Variational Perspective on JEPA

3.1 问题表述Problem Formulation

我们首先提出一个简单的结构性问题：We began by asking a simple structural question:如果 JEPA 中的预测嵌入步骤被解释为耦合 VAE 的变分后验，那么什么生成模型会产生这些后验？if the predictive embedding steps in JEPA were interpreted as variational posteriors of a coupled VAE, what generative model would give rise to those posteriors?

这种观点自然会引导我们在概率潜变量框架内对 JEPA 进行新颖的重新解释。具体来说，我们用条件分布替换 JEPA 的确定性编码器和预测器，并将预测路径解释为学习的潜在空间条件先验。这在上下文、目标和辅助潜在变量上创建了一个清晰的生成过程，从中出现了单个变分目标（ELBO）。我们的公式将 JEPA 式的预测学习与重建和条件生成结合起来，同时提供了通过潜在正则化避免崩溃的严格机制。This viewpoint naturally leads us to a novel reinterpretation of JEPA within a probabilistic latent-variable framework. Concretely, we replace JEPA’s deterministic encoders and predictor with conditional distributions and interpret the predictive pathway as a learned latent-space conditional prior. This creates a clear generative process over context, target, and auxiliary latent variables, from which a single variational objective (ELBO) emerges. Our formulation unifies JEPA-style predictive learning with reconstruction and conditional generation, while providing a rigorous mechanism for avoiding collapse through latent regularization.

结构。Structure.

与 JEPA 一样，我们的模型基于上下文观察进行操作Like JEPA, our model operates on context observationsx∈ℝDx\in\mathbb{R}^{D}和目标观察and target observationsy∈ℝDy\in\mathbb{R}^{D}，学习潜在表征, learning latent representationssx∈ℝds_{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{d}（上下文），(context),sy∈ℝds_{y}\in\mathbb{R}^{d}（目标），以及(target), andz∈ℝdzz\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{z}}（辅助预测变量来捕捉变化(auxiliary predictive variable to capture variability insys_{y}那个thatsxs_{x}无法解释）。有向无环图 (DAG) 遵循底层生成过程：cannot explain). The directed acyclic graph (DAG) follows the underlying generative process:

虽然标准 JEPA 主要使用从观察到表示的单向映射（While a standard JEPA primarily operates with unidirectional mappings from observations to representations (x→sx,y→syx\rightarrow s_{x},y\rightarrow s_{y}），我们的变分框架需要双向关系来对生成过程和推理过程进行建模。对于上下文和目标，我们学习两个方向：编码（从观察到潜在）和重建（从潜在回到观察）。单个 ELBO 目标将这些方向联系在一起，并联合训练编码器和解码器。), our variational framework requires bidirectional relationships to model both the generative and inference processes. For both the context and target, we learn two directions: encoding (from observations to latents) and reconstruction (from latents back to observations). A single ELBO objective ties these directions together and trains encoders and decoders jointly.

pθ​(x,y,sx,z,sy)=\displaystyle p_{\theta}(x,y,s_{x},z,s_{y})= p​(sx)⋅p​(z)⋅pθ​(x∣sx)\displaystyle p(s_{x})\cdot p(z)\cdot p_{\theta}(x\mid s_{x}) (4)
⋅pθ​(sy∣sx,z)⋅pθ​(y∣sy).\displaystyle\cdot p_{\theta}(s_{y}\mid s_{x},z)\cdot p_{\theta}(y\mid s_{y}).
生成模型参数化。Generative Model Parameterization.

我们将生成模型中的分布实现为高斯分布。潜在变量的先验是标准高斯分布，而条件分布由神经网络参数化：We implement distributions in the generative model as Gaussians. The priors over latent variables are standard Gaussians, while the conditional distributions are parameterized by neural networks:

p​(sx)\displaystyle p(s_{x}) =𝒩​(sx; 0,I),\displaystyle=\mathcal{N}(s_{x};\,0,\,I), (5a)
p​(z)\displaystyle p(z) =𝒩​(z; 0,I),\displaystyle=\mathcal{N}(z;\,0,\,I), (5b)
pθ​(x∣sx)\displaystyle p_{\theta}(x\mid s_{x}) =𝒩​(x;Uθx​(sx),σx2​I),\displaystyle=\mathcal{N}\bigl(x;\,U^{x}_{\theta}(s_{x}),\,\sigma_{x}^{2}I\bigr), (5c)
pθ​(sy∣sx,z)\displaystyle p_{\theta}(s_{y}\mid s_{x},z) =𝒩​(sy;μθsy​(sx,z),Σθsy​(sx,z)),\displaystyle=\mathcal{N}\bigl(s_{y};\,\mu_{\theta}^{s_{y}}(s_{x},z),\,\Sigma_{\theta}^{s_{y}}(s_{x},z)\bigr), (5d)
pθ​(y∣sy)\displaystyle p_{\theta}(y\mid s_{y}) =𝒩​(y;Uθy​(sy),σy2​I).\displaystyle=\mathcal{N}\bigl(y;\,U^{y}_{\theta}(s_{y}),\,\sigma_{y}^{2}I\bigr). (5e)

解码器网络The decoder networksUθx:ℝDhid→ℝDobsU_{\theta}^{x}\colon\mathbb{R}^{D_{\text{hid}}}\!\to\!\mathbb{R}^{D_{\text{obs}}}和andUθy:ℝDhid→ℝDobsU_{\theta}^{y}\colon\mathbb{R}^{D_{\text{hid}}}\!\to\!\mathbb{R}^{D_{\text{obs}}}从潜在的表征中重建观察结果，其中reconstruct observations from their latent representations, whereDobsD_{\text{obs}}代表观察维度。预测网络输出represents the observation dimension. The predictive network outputsμθsy​(sx,z)\mu_{\theta}^{s_{y}}(s_{x},z)和andΣθsy​(sx,z)\Sigma_{\theta}^{s_{y}}(s_{x},z)由具有参数的神经网络计算are computed by neural networks with parametersθ\theta，生成目标潜在的分布参数, generating distributional parameters for the target latentsys_{y}以上下文为条件conditioned on contextsxs_{x}和辅助变量and auxiliary variablezz。重建噪声参数. The reconstruction noise parametersσx2\sigma_{x}^{2}和andσy2\sigma_{y}^{2}可以设置为 1 或全局学习以模拟观测不确定性。may be set to 1 or learned globally to model observation uncertainty.

3.2 变分后验Variational Posterior

由于方程中的积分。Since the integral in Eq.3.1在给定的分解和参数化下是棘手的，由于复杂的神经网络函数和高维潜在空间，我们无法优化is intractable under the given factorization and parameterization, due to complex neural network functions and high-dimensional latent spaces, we cannot optimizelog⁡pθ​(x,y)\log p_{\theta}(x,y)直接。相反，我们通过引入易处理的变分后验来采用变分推理方法directly. Instead, we employ a variational inference approach by introducing a tractable variational posteriorqϕ​(sx,z,sy∣x,y)q_{\phi}(s_{x},z,s_{y}\mid x,y)作为真实后验的近似as an approximation of the true posteriorp​(sx,z,sy∣x,y)p(s_{x},z,s_{y}\mid x,y)，并通过具有参数的神经网络进行参数化, and parameterized by neural networks with parametersϕ\phi。我们将变分后验因式分解为：. We factorize the variational posterior as:

qϕ​(sx,z,sy∣x,y)\displaystyle q_{\phi}(s_{x},z,s_{y}\mid x,y) =qϕ​(sx∣x)⋅qϕ​(z∣sx)\displaystyle=q_{\phi}(s_{x}\mid x)\cdot q_{\phi}(z\mid s_{x}) (6)
⋅qϕ​(sy∣sx,z,y).\displaystyle\quad\cdot q_{\phi}(s_{y}\mid s_{x},z,y).

我们采用这种因式分解的原因如下：We adopt this factorization for the following reasons:

  • •

    潜在的上下文The context latentqϕ​(sx∣x)q_{\phi}(s_{x}\mid x)仅取决于上下文观察depends only on the context observationxx，确保上下文表示的学习独立于目标信息。, ensuring that context representations are learned independently of target information.

  • •

    辅助潜伏The auxiliary latentzz仅取决于上下文表示depends only on the context representationsxs_{x}防止训练过程中目标信息泄露。to prevent information leakage from targets during training.

  • •

    目标后验The target posteriorqϕ​(sy|sx,z,y)q_{\phi}(s_{y}|s_{x},z,y)取决于两者depends on bothsxs_{x}和andzz以及目标观察as well as the target observationyy，因为我们将使用重建项来规范学习, as we will use a reconstruction term to regularize the learning ofsys_{y}对有意义的目标信息进行编码，确保通过适当的预测关系而不是琐碎的捷径来学习对上下文的依赖。to encode meaningful target information, ensuring that the dependence on context is learned through proper predictive relationships rather than trivial shortcuts.

变分后验参数化。Variational Posterior Parameterization.

变分后验的每个分量都被参数化为具有可学习均值和协方差的高斯分布：Each component of the variational posterior is parameterized as a Gaussian distribution with learnable mean and covariance:

qϕ​(sx∣x)\displaystyle q_{\phi}(s_{x}\mid x) =𝒩​(sx;μϕsx​(x),Σϕsx​(x)),\displaystyle=\mathcal{N}\bigl(s_{x};\,\mu_{\phi}^{s_{x}}(x),\,\Sigma_{\phi}^{s_{x}}(x)\bigr), (7a)
qϕ​(z∣sx)\displaystyle q_{\phi}(z\mid s_{x}) =𝒩​(z;μϕz​(sx),Σϕz​(sx)),\displaystyle=\mathcal{N}\bigl(z;\,\mu_{\phi}^{z}(s_{x}),\,\Sigma_{\phi}^{z}(s_{x})\bigr), (7b)
qϕ​(sy∣sx,z,y)\displaystyle\!\!\!\!q_{\phi}(s_{y}\!\mid\!s_{x},z,y)\! =𝒩​(sy;μϕsy​(sx,z,y),Σϕsy​(sx,z,y)).\displaystyle=\!\mathcal{N}\bigl(s_{y};\mu_{\phi}^{s_{y}}(s_{x},z,y),\Sigma_{\phi}^{s_{y}}(s_{x},z,y)\bigr). (7c)

推理网络The inference networksμϕsx\mu_{\phi}^{s_{x}}, Σϕsx\Sigma_{\phi}^{s_{x}}, μϕz\mu_{\phi}^{z}, Σϕz\Sigma_{\phi}^{z}, μϕsy\mu_{\phi}^{s_{y}}, 和, andΣϕsy\Sigma_{\phi}^{s_{y}}被实现为神经网络，在给定各自输入的情况下输出分布参数。are implemented as neural networks that output the distributional parameters given their respective inputs.

  • ℒzKL\mathcal{L}^{\text{KL}}_{z}

    • (一)(a)

      （预测）(Prediction)：衡量预测准确性——有多好: Measures the predictive accuracy–how wellsxs_{x}和辅助变量and auxiliary variablezz可以联合预测目标潜在表示can jointly forecast the target latent representationsys_{y}.

    • (二)(b)

      （熵）(Entropy)：保持目标后验的分布多样性: Maintains distributional diversity of the target posteriorqϕ​(sy∣sx,z,y)q_{\phi}(s_{y}\!\mid\!s_{x},z,y)通过鼓励它保持足够的不确定性，从而防止崩溃。by encouraging it to remain sufficiently uncertain, therefore preventing collapse.

3.4 JEPA 与 Var-JEPA 架构JEPA vs. Var-JEPA Architectures

图。Fig.1说明了标准 JEPA 和我们的 Var-JEPA 之间的关系。两种方法与上下文共享相同的核心预测结构（illustrates the relationship between standard JEPA and our Var-JEPA. Both approaches share the same core prediction structure with context (xx) 和目标 () and target (yy) 观察结果，它们的潜在表征) observations, their latent representationssx,sys_{x},s_{y}，和辅助潜变量, and auxiliary latent variablezz。 JEPA 依赖于推理和预测网络，这需要替代成本. JEPA relies on inference and prediction networks, which requires surrogate costsC​(⋅)C(\cdot)以免代表崩溃。 Var-JEPA 添加了生成网络（即解码器），因此可以使用变分目标来训练模型，从而自然地防止崩溃。to prevent the collapse of representations. Var‑JEPA adds generative networks (i.e., decoders) so the model can be trained with a variational objective which naturally prevents collapse.

3.5 重新参数化技巧和采样实现Reparameterization Trick and Sampling Implementation

为了通过随机潜在变量进行反向传播，我们应用了重新参数化技巧To backpropagate through stochastic latents, we apply the reparameterization trick(Kingma and Welling, 2013)，将样本表示为噪声的确定性函数，因此梯度是明确定义的。使用以下重新参数化形式对潜在变量进行采样：, expressing samples as deterministic functions of noise so gradients are well-defined. The latent variables are sampled using the following reparameterized forms:

sx\displaystyle s_{x} =μϕsx​(x)+[Σϕsx​(x)]1/2​ϵsx,\displaystyle=\mu_{\phi}^{s_{x}}(x)+\bigl[\Sigma_{\phi}^{s_{x}}(x)\bigr]^{1/2}\,\epsilon_{s_{x}},
z\displaystyle z =μϕz​(sx)+[Σϕz​(sx)]1/2​ϵz,\displaystyle=\mu_{\phi}^{z}(s_{x})+\bigl[\Sigma_{\phi}^{z}(s_{x})\bigr]^{1/2}\,\epsilon_{z},
sy\displaystyle s_{y} =μϕsy​(sx,z,y)+[Σϕsy​(sx,z,y)]1/2​ϵsy,\displaystyle=\mu_{\phi}^{s_{y}}(s_{x},z,y)+\bigl[\Sigma_{\phi}^{s_{y}}(s_{x},z,y)\bigr]^{1/2}\,\epsilon_{s_{y}},

哪里whereϵsx,ϵz,ϵsy∼𝒩​(0,I)\epsilon_{s_{x}},\epsilon_{z},\epsilon_{s_{y}}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,I)是独立的标准高斯噪声向量，并且are independent standard Gaussian noise vectors, and[Σϕ(⋅)​(⋅)]1/2[\Sigma_{\phi}^{(\cdot)}(\cdot)]^{1/2}表示协方差的矩阵平方根。在实践中，我们通过对每个前向传播的每个潜在变量的单个实现进行采样来估计梯度。梯度估计器变为：denotes the matrix square root of the covariance. In practice, we estimate the gradients by sampling a single realization of each latent variable per forward pass. The gradient estimator becomes:

∇θ,ϕℒ≈∇θ,ϕ[log⁡pθ​(x,y,sx,z,sy)−log⁡qϕ​(sx,z,sy∣x,y)],\nabla_{\!\theta,\phi}\,\mathcal{L}\!\approx\!\nabla_{\theta,\phi}\!\bigl[\log p_{\theta}(x,\!y,\!s_{x},\!z,\!s_{y})-\log q_{\phi}(s_{x},\!z,\!s_{y}\!\!\mid\!\!x,y)\bigr],

每个训练步骤都使用新样本where each training step uses new samplessx,z,sys_{x},z,s_{y}从重新参数化的分布中得出。drawn from the reparameterized distributions.

3.6 理论生成推理Theoretical Generative Inference

当 Var-JEPA 被解释为真正的生成模型时，它可以通过生成路径进行采样，从上下文中生成目标观察结果。当目标不可用时适用的生成推理过程是：When Var-JEPA is interpreted as a truly generative model, it can generate target observations from context by sampling through the generative pathway. The generative inference procedure, applicable when targets are unavailable, is:

4 实验Experiments

4.1 模拟研究Simulation Study

我们在受控合成环境中评估 Var-JEPA，该环境旨在隔离潜在正则化、各向同性和信息瓶颈的影响，同时保留已知的真实生成过程。此设置使我们能够分析变分目标如何形成聚合潜在分布，以及这反过来如何影响下游探针性能。We evaluate Var-JEPA in a controlled synthetic setting designed to isolate the effects of latent regularisation, isotropy, and information bottlenecks while retaining a known ground-truth generative process. This setting allows us to analyse how the variational objective shapes the aggregated latent distribution and how this, in turn, affects downstream probe performance.

4.2 表格数据的下游评估Downstream Evaluation on Tabular Data

4.2.1 实验细节Experimental Details

Var-T-JEPA。Var-T-JEPA.

我们评估了我们的表格实现 Var-T-JEPA，它将特征级屏蔽与等式 1 中的统一变分目标相结合。We evaluate our tabular implementation, Var-T-JEPA, which combines feature-level masking with the unified variational objective from Eq.10。该模型的灵感来自确定性 T-JEPA. The model is inspired by the deterministic T-JEPA(Thimonier et al., 2025)，但是通过学习高斯潜在嵌入并在 ELBO 下联合训练预测和重建路径来实例化表格数据的 Var-JEPA 框架。 Var-T-JEPA 将异构数值和分类特征标记为转换器序列，推断高斯潜在嵌入, but instantiates the Var-JEPA framework for tabular data by learning Gaussian latent embeddings and training the prediction and reconstruction pathways jointly under the ELBO. Var-T-JEPA tokenizes heterogeneous numerical and categorical features into a transformer sequence, infers Gaussian latent embeddingssxs_{x}和andsys_{y}，并通过耦合重建预测目标训练潜在空间预测器，该目标直接实例化异构表格数据的 Var-JEPA 框架。这会产生确定性嵌入（通过后验平均值）和来自学习的潜在分布的每个样本的不确定性估计。我们将完整的概念描述推迟到附录中, and trains a latent-space predictor via a coupled reconstruction–prediction objective that directly instantiates the Var-JEPA framework for heterogeneous tabular data. This yields both deterministic embeddings (via posterior means) and per-sample uncertainty estimates from the learned latent distributions. We defer a full conceptual description to AppendixA.

数据集。Datasets.

我们评估了五个现实世界表格数据集的学习表示：Adult (AD)、Covertype (CO)、Electricity (EL)、Credit Card (CC) 和 Bank Marketing (BM)，以及 MNIST（被视为具有可控输入损坏的表格特征）和完全合成的模拟数据集 (SIM)；附录中提供了更多详细信息We evaluate learned representations on five real-world tabular datasets: Adult (AD), Covertype (CO), Electricity (EL), Credit Card (CC), and Bank Marketing (BM), as well as MNIST (treated as tabular features with controllable input corruption) and a fully-synthetic simulation dataset (SIM); more details are provided in AppendixC.1.1.

下游和基线预测因子。Downstream and baseline predictors.

对于每个数据集，我们将强大的原始特征基线与在 Var-T-JEPA 和 T-JEPA 生成的嵌入上训练的相同预测器架构进行比较（附录中详细信息）For each dataset, we compare strong raw-feature baselines to the same predictor architectures trained on embeddings produced by Var-T-JEPA and T-JEPA (details in AppendixD.5）。正在关注). FollowingThimonier et al. (2025），我们考虑一系列强大且广泛使用的表格预测器：MLP、DCNv2), we consider a range of strong and widely-used tabular predictors: MLP, DCNv2(Wang et al., 2021), 残差网络, ResNet(He et al., 2016), 自动输入, AutoInt(Song et al., 2019), FT-变压器, FT-Transformer(Gorishniy et al., 2021)和XGBoost, and XGBoost(Chen and Guestrin, 2016).

通过不确定性进行选择性评估。Selective evaluation via uncertainty.

Var-T-JEPA 提供每个样本的不确定性估计；我们报告了最不确定的选择性评估Var-T-JEPA provides a per-sample uncertainty estimate; we report selective-evaluation where the most uncertain10%10\%, 20%20\%, 或, or50%50\%的样本在计算准确性之前被丢弃（“Var-T-JEPA (10%)”等），说明了放弃低置信度样本时的覆盖率与准确性的权衡。of samples are discarded before computing accuracy (“Var-T-JEPA (10%)”, etc.), illustrating the coverage–accuracy trade-off when abstaining on low-confidence samples.

4.2.2 结果Results

表Table2总结了跨数据集和预测变量系列的下游测试准确性。在现实世界的表格数据集（AD、CO、EL、CC、BM）中，Var-T-JEPA 为下游分类器生成有竞争力的嵌入，并且选择性评估表现出明确的覆盖率与准确性权衡：丢弃最不确定的测试样本可以提高跨模型系列保留子集的性能。相比之下，确定性 T-JEPA 基线可能会在某些数据集上遭受表示崩溃的影响，从而导致下游性能不佳并降低稳健性。summarizes downstream test accuracy across datasets and predictor families. Across the real-world tabular datasets (AD, CO, EL, CC, BM), Var-T-JEPA yields competitive embeddings for downstream classifiers, and selective evaluation exhibits a clear coverage–accuracy trade-off: discarding the most uncertain test samples improves performance on the retained subset across model families. In contrast, the deterministic T-JEPA baseline can suffer from representation collapse on some datasets, leading to poor downstream performance and reduced robustness.

对于（半）合成 MNIST 和 SIM 数据集，Var-T-JEPA 还生成与底层模拟损坏/模糊结构一致的不确定性信号：图For the (semi-)synthetic MNIST and SIM datasets, Var-T-JEPA additionally produces uncertainty signals that are consistent with the underlying simulated corruption/ambiguity structure: Figure3可视化（左）因对潜在不确定性最高的样本放弃而引起的风险覆盖曲线，（中）标准化潜在不确定性与模拟不确定性得分之间的正相关关系，以及（右）ROC曲线显示潜在不确定性可以识别高模糊性样本（由模拟不确定性得分的高分位数阈值定义）。这些诊断补充了表中的选择性评估结果visualizes (left) risk–coverage curves induced by abstaining on samples with highest latent uncertainty, (middle) a positive association between standardized latent uncertainty and the simulated uncertainty score, and (right) ROC curves showing that latent uncertainty can identify high-ambiguity samples (defined by a high-quantile threshold on the simulated uncertainty score). These diagnostics complement the selective-evaluation results in Table2通过表明习得的潜在不确定性不仅对弃权有用，而且与这些受控环境中已知的不确定性信号相一致。附录中提供了其他实验结果，包括敏感性分析by showing that the learned latent uncertainty is not only useful for abstention, but also aligned with the known uncertainty signal in these controlled settings. 5 讨论Discussion

我们对 JEPA 设计模式进行了新颖的重新解释，将其视为耦合潜变量模型中的变分推理：预测变量是学习的条件先验We provide a novel reinterpretation of the JEPA design pattern as variational inference in a coupled latent-variable model: the predictor is a learned conditional priorpθ​(sy∣sx,z)p_{\theta}(s_{y}\mid s_{x},z)，临时成本是 ELBO 规范化的分配控制的间接形式。这澄清了常见的“JEPA 与生成建模”二分法在很大程度上是一个框架问题：JEPA 在潜变量生成模型的设计空间中占据了一个特定的（隐式的，通常是确定性的）点。通过使这种潜在的生成结构变得明确，我们将预测性和生成性自我监督学习统一在一个原则框架内。根据经验，ELBO 训练可以产生可用的表示，而无需启发式反崩溃目标（例如，辅助正则化器，如 EMA 或分布匹配惩罚），并且可以根据后验协方差进行严格的不确定性估计。我们引入 Var-T-JEPA 作为表格数据的具体实现，在下游表格评估中，它在各种数据集上产生竞争性嵌入，并支持基于估计的潜在不确定性的选择性预测。更广泛地说，我们观察到固定先验的每个样本 KL 项驱动聚合分布行为，与 SIGReg 等显式分布正则化器相当，同时让目标潜在受其学习的条件先验控制。未来的工作包括扩展到视觉和视频，并扩展到测试时缺乏目标观察的设置，从而使条件生成成为中心。, and ad hoc costs are indirect forms of distributional control that the ELBO regularizes. This clarifies that the common “JEPA vs. generative modeling” dichotomy is largely a matter of framing: JEPA occupies a particular (implicit, often deterministic) point in the design space of latent-variable generative models. By making this latent generative structure explicit, we unify predictive and generative self-supervised learning within a single principled framework. Empirically, ELBO training yields usable representations without heuristic anti-collapse objectives (e.g., auxiliary regularizers such as EMA or distribution-matching penalties) and enables rigorous uncertainty estimates from posterior covariances. We introduce Var-T-JEPA as a concrete implementation for tabular data, and in downstream tabular evaluation it produces competitive embeddings across various datasets and supports selective prediction based on estimated latent uncertainty. More broadly, we observe that per-sample KL terms to fixed priors drive aggregated distributional behavior comparable to explicit distributional regularizers such as SIGReg, while leaving the target latent governed by its learned conditional prior. Future work includes scaling to vision and video, and extending to settings where target observations are absent at test time, making conditional generation central.

附录AAppendix AVar-T-JEPA：表格数据的变分联合嵌入预测架构Var-T-JEPA: Variational Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture for Tabular Data

A.1 概述：神经架构和建模策略Overview: Neural Architecture and Modeling Strategies

下面提供了 Var-T-JEPA 的完整概念概述。详细实施规范请参见附录The following provides a full conceptual overview of Var-T-JEPA. Detailed implementation specifications are deferred to AppendixD.2.

表格数据在几个方面与 JEPA 应用程序中经常遇到的图像或文本模式有根本的不同：（1）特征本质上是异构的，混合了具有不同尺度和分布的数值和分类变量； (2) 不存在空间或时间局部性的概念，需要替代的掩蔽策略； (3) 特征交互通常复杂且不明显，使得预测任务特别适合 JEPA 等表示学习方法。Tabular data differs fundamentally from image or text modalities often encountered in JEPA applications in several aspects: (1) features are inherently heterogeneous, mixing numerical and categorical variables with different scales and distributions; (2) the notion of spatial or temporal locality is absent, requiring alternative masking strategies; (3) feature interactions are often complex and non-obvious, making the predictive task particularly suitable for representation learning approaches like JEPA.

我们的表格 Var-T-JEPA 管道广泛建立在以下人员建立的建模策略之上：Our tabular Var-T-JEPA pipeline broadly builds on modeling strategies established byThimonier et al. (2025），他引入了 T-JEPA 作为表格数据的标准（非变分）JEPA 实现。我们的表格 Var-T-JEPA 模型的模型架构如图 1 所示。), who introduced T-JEPA as a standard (non-variational) JEPA implementation for tabular data. The model architecture of our tabular Var-T-JEPA model is depicted in Fig.4，翻译了第 1 节的理论框架, which translates the theoretical framework from Section3转化为为表格数据量身定制的实用神经架构。into a practical neural architecture tailored for tabular data.

A.4 展望：视觉和视频的扩展Outlook: Extension to Vision and Video

我们将 Var-JEPA 实现为 Var-T-JEPA，以在易于进行仔细消融和不确定性分析的环境中提供计算高效的概念验证。然而，该公式并不特定于表格数据，可以直接转移到与 I-JEPA 非常相似的视觉模式We implemented Var-JEPA as Var-T-JEPA to provide a compute-efficient proof-of-concept in a setting where careful ablations and uncertainty analyses are tractable. However, the formulation is not specific to tabular data and can be transferred directly to visual modalities in close analogy to I-JEPA(Assran et al., 2023)。具体来说，我们可以（i）将图像/视频标记为补丁或小管序列，（ii）定义屏蔽上下文视图. Concretely, one can (i) tokenize images/videos into patch or tubelet sequences, (ii) define a masked context viewxx和蒙版目标视图and masked target viewyy, (iii) 参数化, (iii) parameterizeqϕ​(sx∣x)q_{\phi}(s_{x}\!\mid\!x)和andqϕ​(sy∣sx,z,y)q_{\phi}(s_{y}\!\mid\!s_{x},z,y)使用基于 ViT 的编码器和with ViT-based encoders andpθ​(sy∣sx,z)p_{\theta}(s_{y}\!\mid\!s_{x},z)使用轻量级预测器（如 I-JEPA），以及 (iv) 添加解码器with a lightweight predictor (as in I-JEPA), and (iv) add a decoderpθ​(y∣sy)p_{\theta}(y\!\mid\!s_{y})（例如，高斯像素或离散标记似然）以获得 ELBO 目标。这产生了视觉/视频的 JEPA 式表示预测的生成式、不确定性感知模拟，同时保留了预测器的相同条件先验解释。(e.g., Gaussian pixels or discrete token likelihoods) to obtain the ELBO objective. This yields a generative, uncertainty-aware analogue of JEPA-style representation prediction for vision/video, while retaining the same conditional-prior interpretation of the predictor.

我们的实验评估有意侧重于验证我们在 JEPA 框架内的概念贡献（桥接 JEPA 和变分推理）——强调崩溃预防、不确定性量化以及每个样本和聚合正则化之间的关系——而不是针对更广泛的自监督学习环境进行全面基准测试。为了补充正文中报告的准确性结果，我们在下面提供 F1 分数评估和敏感性分析。Our experimental evaluation intentionally focuses on validating our conceptual contribution (bridging JEPA and variational inference) within the JEPA framework–emphasizing collapse prevention, uncertainty quantification, and the relationship between per-sample and aggregated regularization–rather than comprehensive benchmarking against the broader self-supervised learning landscape. To complement the accuracy results reported in the main text, we provide F1-score evaluations and sensitivity analyses below.

我们的模拟数据集旨在为大多数样本生成良好分离的类结构，同时通过原型混合在样本子集的原始特征空间中引入受控的不确定性。具体来说，我们在 28 维数值空间中生成三个具有共享各向同性方差的类条件高斯簇。然后我们绘制每个样本的模糊度分数Our simulated dataset is designed to produce well-separated class structure for most samples, while inducing controlled uncertainty in the original feature space for a subset of samples through prototype mixing. Concretely, we generate three class-conditional Gaussian clusters in a 28-dimensional numeric space with shared isotropic variance. We then draw a per-sample ambiguity score(ui∼Uniform​(0,1))(u_{i}\sim\mathrm{Uniform}(0,1))并将其映射到放大的不确定性/模糊性强度and map it to an amplified uncertainty/ambiguity strength(ui(amb)=uiγ)(u_{i}^{(\mathrm{amb})}=u_{i}^{\gamma})与with(γ=2)(\gamma=2)。这样做时，大多数样本都很简单，只有一小部分变得高度模糊。对于每个样本. In doing so, most samples are easy and only a fraction become highly ambiguous. For each sample(i)(i)具有真正的阶级with true class(c)(c)，我们选择一个替代类, we select an alternative class(c′)(c^{\prime})并将数字特征与强度混合到替代类原型中and blend the numeric features toward the alternative class prototype with strength(αi∝ui(amb))(\alpha_{i}\propto u_{i}^{(\mathrm{amb})})。我们进一步（i）将数字特征的随机子集混合到替代原型中，并且（ii）在一小部分信息维度中注入额外的模糊驱动噪声。最后，我们通过对选定的数字维度进行分位数分箱并以概率增加的方式翻转分类值，得出四个分类变量. We further (i) mix a random subset of numeric features toward the alternative prototype, and (ii) inject additional ambiguity-driven noise in a small set of informative dimensions. Finally, we derive four categorical variables by quantile-binning selected numeric dimensions and flip categorical values with probability increasing inui(amb)u_{i}^{(\mathrm{amb})}。输出包括 28 个数字特征、4 个分类特征和 3 个类别。. The output includes 28 numeric features, 4 categorical features, and 3 classes.

D.1 用于模拟研究的 Var-JEPA 实现Var-JEPA Implementation for Simulation Study

模拟研究实现了最小的 Var-JEPA 变体，以隔离真实潜变量数据生成器下每个样本 KL 正则化和聚合分布正则化 (SIGReg) 的影响。我们实现了基于 MLP 的 Var-JEPA，具有摊销高斯后验The simulation study implements a minimal Var-JEPA variant to isolate the effects of per-sample KL regularization and aggregated-distribution regularization (SIGReg) under a ground-truth latent-variable data generator. qϕ​(syk(j)|sx,z,w;mtrg(k))=𝒩​(syk(j);μϕsw​(hfeat)(j),Σϕsw​(hfeat)(j))​ for ​j∈mtrg(k)q_{\phi}(s_{y_{k}}^{(j)}|s_{x},z,w;m_{\text{trg}}^{(k)})=\mathcal{N}(s_{y_{k}}^{(j)};\mu_{\phi}^{s_{w}}(h_{\text{feat}})^{(j)},\Sigma_{\phi}^{s_{w}}(h_{\text{feat}})^{(j)})\text{ for }j\in m_{\text{trg}}^{(k)} (41)

哪里wherehfeath_{\text{feat}}表示从中提取的特征标记表示denotes the feature token representations extracted fromhaugh_{\text{aug}}.

D.2.4 预测模型实施Predictive Model Implementation

预测模型The predictive modelpθ​(syk(j)|sx,z;mtrg(k))p_{\theta}(s_{y_{k}}^{(j)}|s_{x},z;m_{\text{trg}}^{(k)})使用可学习的掩码令牌完全在潜在空间中运行。与目标后验不同，它无法访问原始目标特征，并且必须根据上下文和辅助信息预测潜在表示：operates entirely in latent space using learnable mask tokens. Unlike the target posterior, it has no access to raw target features and must predict latent representations from context and auxiliary information:

hctx\displaystyle h_{\text{ctx}} =Linear​(sx)+Linear​(z)+eposctx\displaystyle=\text{Linear}(s_{x})+\text{Linear}(z)+e_{\text{pos}}^{\text{ctx}} (42)
hmask\displaystyle h_{\text{mask}} =MaskToken+Linear​(z)+epostrg\displaystyle=\text{MaskToken}+\text{Linear}(z)+e_{\text{pos}}^{\text{trg}} (43)
hpred\displaystyle h_{\text{pred}} =Transformer​(concat​(hctx,hmask))\displaystyle=\text{Transformer}(\text{concat}(h_{\text{ctx}},h_{\text{mask}})) (44)
μθsy​(hpred),Σθsy​(hpred)\displaystyle\mu_{\theta}^{s_{y}}(h_{\text{pred}}),\Sigma_{\theta}^{s_{y}}(h_{\text{pred}}) =Linear​(hpred),Linear​(hpred)\displaystyle=\text{Linear}(h_{\text{pred}}),\text{Linear}(h_{\text{pred}}) (45)
pθ​(syk(j)|sx,z;mtrg(k))\displaystyle p_{\theta}(s_{y_{k}}^{(j)}|s_{x},z;m_{\text{trg}}^{(k)}) =𝒩​(syk(j);μθsy​(hpred)(j),Σθsy​(hpred)(j))\displaystyle=\mathcal{N}(s_{y_{k}}^{(j)};\mu_{\theta}^{s_{y}}(h_{\text{pred}})^{(j)},\Sigma_{\theta}^{s_{y}}(h_{\text{pred}})^{(j)}) (46)

预测模型不直接区分分类特征和数值特征，因为它纯粹在潜在表示空间中工作。The predictive model does not directly distinguish between categorical and numerical features since it works purely in the latent representation space.

预测器为每个目标掩模生成顺序目标预测，使模型能够在训练期间同时处理多个预测任务。至关重要的是，该组件无法访问目标观察结果，从而维持了预测学习的 JEPA 原则。The predictor generates sequential target predictions for each target mask, enabling the model to handle multiple prediction tasks simultaneously during training. Crucially, this component has no access to target observations, maintaining the JEPA principle of predictive learning.

D.2.5 上下文和目标解码器实现Context and Target Decoder Implementation

上下文和目标解码器使用特定于特征的解码器头从其潜在表示重建原始表格特征。两种解码器共享相同的架构，但在不同的潜在序列上运行。The context and target decoders reconstruct original tabular features from their latent representations using feature-specific decoder heads. Both decoders share identical architectures but operate on different latent sequences.

特定功能的解码器架构。Feature-specific decoder architecture.

每个解码器为数据集中的每个原始特征维护单独的神经网络头：Each decoder maintains separate neural network heads for every original feature in the dataset:

NumericDecoders ={uθ(j):ℝDhid→ℝ1∣j∈ℐnum}\displaystyle=\{u_{\theta}^{(j)}:\mathbb{R}^{D_{\text{hid}}}\to\mathbb{R}^{1}\mid j\in\mathcal{I}_{\text{num}}\} (47)
CategoricalDecoders ={uθ(j):ℝDhid→ℝCj∣j∈ℐcat}\displaystyle=\{u_{\theta}^{(j)}:\mathbb{R}^{D_{\text{hid}}}\to\mathbb{R}^{C_{j}}\mid j\in\mathcal{I}_{\text{cat}}\} (48)

哪里whereCjC_{j}表示分类特征的基数denotes the cardinality of categorical featurejj。每个解码器头被实现为特定于特征类型和索引的线性层。. Each decoder head is implemented as a linear layer specific to the feature type and index.

上下文解码器处理。Context decoder processing.

给定上下文潜在序列Given a context latent sequencesx∈ℝMctx.×Dhids_{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{M_{\text{ctx}.}\times D_{\text{hid}}}和上下文特征索引and context feature indicesmctx∈ℝMctxm_{\text{ctx}}\in\mathbb{R}^{M_{\text{ctx}}}，上下文解码器处理每个潜在标记：, the context decoder processes each latent token:

for t=1,…,Mctx:j=mctx[t],x^(j)=uθ(j)(sx(t))\text{for }t=1,\ldots,M_{\text{ctx}}:\quad j=m_{\text{ctx}}[t],\quad\hat{x}^{(j)}=u_{\theta}^{(j)}(s_{x}^{(t)}) (49)
目标解码器处理。Target decoder processing.

目标解码器遵循相同的处理并直接对目标潜在序列进行操作：The target decoder follows identical processing and operates directly on target latent sequences:

w^(j)=uθ(j)​(sw(j))\hat{w}^{(j)}=u_{\theta}^{(j)}(s_{w}^{(j)}) (50)
重建分布。Reconstruction distributions.

解码器输出被解释为任何观察的分布参数The decoder outputs are interpreted as distributional parameters for any observationπ∈{x,w}\pi\in\{x,w\}具有相应的潜在表征with corresponding latent representationsπs_{\pi}:

pθ​(π(j)|sπ(j))={𝒩​(π(j);uθ(j)​(sπ(j)),σ2)if ​j∈ℐnumCategorical​(π(j);softmax​(uθ(j)​(sπ(j))))if ​j∈ℐcatp_{\theta}(\pi^{(j)}|s_{\pi}^{(j)})=\begin{cases}\mathcal{N}(\pi^{(j)};u_{\theta}^{(j)}(s_{\pi}^{(j)}),\sigma^{2})&\text{if }j\in\mathcal{I}_{\text{num}}\\ \text{Categorical}(\pi^{(j)};\text{softmax}(u_{\theta}^{(j)}(s_{\pi}^{(j)})))&\text{if }j\in\mathcal{I}_{\text{cat}}\end{cases} (51)

哪里whereσ2\sigma^{2}是数值重建不确定性的可学习全局噪声参数。完整的重建分布因式分解为is a learnable global noise parameter for numerical reconstruction uncertainty. The full reconstruction distribution factorizes aspθ​(π|sπ)=∏j∈mπpθ​(π(j)|sπ(j))p_{\theta}(\pi|s_{\pi})=\prod_{j\in m_{\pi}}p_{\theta}(\pi^{(j)}|s_{\pi}^{(j)}), 其中, wheremπm_{\pi}表示观察用掩模denotes the mask for observationπ\pi.

D.2.6 KL 分歧KL Divergences

我们计算高斯之间的封闭形式 KL 散度，其由下式给出We compute the closed form KL divergences between Gaussians, which is given by(Murphy, 2022)

KL​(𝒩​(μq,Σq)∥𝒩​(μp,Σp))=12​[+tr​(Σp−1​Σq)+(μp−μq)⊤​Σp−1​(μp−μq)+log⁡detΣpdetΣq−d].\mathrm{KL}\bigl(\mathcal{N}(\mu_{q},\Sigma_{q})\,\big\|\,\mathcal{N}(\mu_{p},\Sigma_{p})\bigr)=\tfrac{1}{2}\Bigl[+\mathrm{tr}\bigl(\Sigma_{p}^{-1}\Sigma_{q}\bigr)+(\mu_{p}-\mu_{q})^{\top}\Sigma_{p}^{-1}(\mu_{p}-\mu_{q})+\log\frac{\det\Sigma_{p}}{\det\Sigma_{q}}-d\Bigr]. (52)

在我们的实现中，所有潜在变量都使用对角协方差矩阵In our implementation, all latent variables use diagonal covariance matricesΣ=diag​(Σ1,…,ΣDhid)\Sigma=\mathrm{diag}(\Sigma_{1},\ldots,\Sigma_{D_{\text{hid}}})其中每个where eachΣd\Sigma_{d}表示维度的方差represents the variance of dimensiondd。正如我们的前人所言. As our priors haveμp=0\mu_{p}=0, Σp=I\Sigma_{p}=I为了forsxs_{x}和andzz，等式。, Eq.52简化为：simplifies to:

KL​(qϕ​(sx(j)|x)∥𝒩​(0,I))\displaystyle\mathrm{KL}\bigl(q_{\phi}(s_{x}^{(j)}|x)\,\|\,\mathcal{N}(0,I)\bigr) =12​∑d=1Dhid[(Σϕsx(j,d))+(μϕsx(j,d))2−log⁡(Σϕsx(j,d))−1]\displaystyle=\tfrac{1}{2}\sum_{d=1}^{D_{\text{hid}}}\Bigl[(\Sigma_{\phi}^{s_{x}^{(j,d)}})+(\mu_{\phi}^{s_{x}^{(j,d)}})^{2}-\log(\Sigma_{\phi}^{s_{x}^{(j,d)}})-1\Bigr]
KL​(qϕ​(z|sx)∥𝒩​(0,I))\displaystyle\mathrm{KL}\bigl(q_{\phi}(z|s_{x})\,\|\,\mathcal{N}(0,I)\bigr) =12​∑d=1Dhid[(Σϕz(d))+(μϕz(d))2−log⁡(Σϕz(d))−1]\displaystyle=\tfrac{1}{2}\sum_{d=1}^{D_{\text{hid}}}\Bigl[(\Sigma_{\phi}^{z^{(d)}})+(\mu_{\phi}^{z^{(d)}})^{2}-\log(\Sigma_{\phi}^{z^{(d)}})-1\Bigr]

两个对角高斯之间的第三个 KL 项变为：The third KL term between two diagonal Gaussians becomes:

KL(qϕ(syk(j)|sx,z,w;mtrg(k))∥pθ(syk(j)|sx,z;mtrg(k)))=12∑d=1Dhid[(Σϕsyk(j,d))(Σθsyk(j,d))+(μθsyk(j,d)−μϕsyk(j,d))2(Σθsyk(j,d))+log(Σθsyk(j,d))(Σϕsyk(j,d))−1]\mathrm{KL}\bigl(q_{\phi}(s_{y_{k}}^{(j)}|s_{x},z,w;m_{\text{trg}}^{(k)})\,\|\,p_{\theta}(s_{y_{k}}^{(j)}|s_{x},z;m_{\text{trg}}^{(k)})\bigr)=\tfrac{1}{2}\sum_{d=1}^{D_{\text{hid}}}\Bigl[\frac{(\Sigma_{\phi}^{s_{y_{k}}^{(j,d)}})}{(\Sigma_{\theta}^{s_{y_{k}}^{(j,d)}})}+\frac{(\mu_{\theta}^{s_{y_{k}}^{(j,d)}}-\mu_{\phi}^{s_{y_{k}}^{(j,d)}})^{2}}{(\Sigma_{\theta}^{s_{y_{k}}^{(j,d)}})}+\log\frac{(\Sigma_{\theta}^{s_{y_{k}}^{(j,d)}})}{(\Sigma_{\phi}^{s_{y_{k}}^{(j,d)}})}-1\Bigr]

哪里whereμϕsyk(j,d)=μϕsw(j,d):j∈mtrg(k)\mu_{\phi}^{s_{y_{k}}^{(j,d)}}=\mu_{\phi}^{s_{w}^{(j,d)}}:j\in m_{\text{trg}}^{(k)}和andΣϕsyk(j,d)=Σϕsw(j,d):j∈mtrg(k)\Sigma_{\phi}^{s_{y_{k}}^{(j,d)}}=\Sigma_{\phi}^{s_{w}^{(j,d)}}:j\in m_{\text{trg}}^{(k)}是目标的屏蔽均值和协方差are the masked means and covariances for targetyky_{k}.

D.3 培训和测试程序Training and Testing Procedure

本节提供训练 Var-T-JEPA 模型的详细实现细节，包括 KL 退火计划和训练算法。This section provides detailed implementation specifics for training the Var-T-JEPA model, including KL annealing schedules and the training algorithm.

D.3.1 KL 散度退火KL Divergence Annealing

ELBO 中的 KL 散度项是在训练过程中通过针对每种潜在变量类型的单独退火计划逐渐引入的。这可以防止后验崩溃并确保稳定的训练动态，这是训练变分自动编码器的常用技术The KL divergence terms in the ELBO are gradually introduced during training through separate annealing schedules for each latent variable type. This prevents posterior collapse and ensures stable training dynamics, a common technique in training variational autoencoders(Bowman et al., 2016)。我们实施具有可配置开始时间和持续时间的线性退火计划：. We implement linear annealing schedules with configurable start times and durations:

αsxKL​(t)\displaystyle\alpha^{\text{KL}}_{s_{x}}(t) =min⁡(tTsxanneal,1)⋅αsx,finalKL\displaystyle=\min\left(\frac{t}{T_{s_{x}}^{\text{anneal}}},1\right)\cdot\alpha^{\text{KL}}_{s_{x},\text{final}} (53)
αzKL​(t)\displaystyle\alpha^{\text{KL}}_{z}(t) =min⁡(tTzanneal,1)⋅αz,finalKL\displaystyle=\min\left(\frac{t}{T_{z}^{\text{anneal}}},1\right)\cdot\alpha^{\text{KL}}_{z,\text{final}} (54)
αsyKL​(t)\displaystyle\alpha^{\text{KL}}_{s_{y}}(t) =min⁡(tTsyanneal,1)⋅αsy,finalKL\displaystyle=\min\left(\frac{t}{T_{s_{y}}^{\text{anneal}}},1\right)\cdot\alpha^{\text{KL}}_{s_{y},\text{final}} (55)

哪里wherett表示当前的训练步骤，denotes the current training step,T⋅annealT_{\cdot}^{\text{anneal}}指定退火持续时间，并且specifies the annealing duration, andα⋅,finalKL\alpha^{\text{KL}}_{\cdot,\text{final}}设置最终重量值。sets the final weight values.

D.3.2 训练算法Training Algorithm

算法Algorithm1概述了 Var-T-JEPA 针对表格数据的完整训练程序。请注意，虽然我们在主论文中使用了每个样本的表示法，但该算法呈现了批次级实现，其中损失项表示小批次的平均值，并且变量按批次内的样本位置进行索引。outlines the complete training procedure for our Var-T-JEPA for tabular data. Note that, while we used a per-sample notation in the main paper, the algorithm presents the batch-level implementation where loss terms represent averages over mini-batches and variables are indexed by sample position within the batch.

D.4 表格数据的 T-JEPA 实施T-JEPA Implementation for Tabular Data

T-JEPA (Thimonier et al., 2025)采用具有三个主要组件的确定性联合嵌入架构：上下文编码器employs a deterministic joint-embedding architecture with three main components: context encoderfθctxf_{\theta}^{\text{ctx}}，目标编码器, target encoderfθtrgf_{\theta}^{\text{trg}}，和预测器, and predictorgθg_{\theta}，如图所示, as illustrated in Figure6.

上下文和目标编码器。Context and target encoders.

两个编码器Both encodersfθctxf_{\theta}^{\text{ctx}}和andfθtrgf_{\theta}^{\text{trg}}共享相同的架构，但对输入的不同屏蔽视图进行操作。 T-JEPA 使用与等式 1 中描述的相同的标记化方案。share identical architectures but operate on different masked views of the input. T-JEPA uses the same tokenization scheme as described in Eq.27和等式。and Eq.37，通过具有类型和位置编码的特定特征嵌入来处理表格特征。标记化特征由变压器编码器处理以产生确定性表示, processing tabular features through feature-specific embeddings with type and positional encodings. The tokenized features are processed by a transformer encoder to produce deterministic representationssx=fθctx​(x)s_{x}=f_{\theta}^{\text{ctx}}(x)和andsy=fθtrg​(w;mtrg)s_{y}=f_{\theta}^{\text{trg}}(w;m_{\text{trg}})分别用于上下文和目标视图。for context and target views respectively.

预测器。Predictor.

如图As shown in Figure6，预测器, the predictorgθg_{\theta}学习根据上下文表示来预测目标表示。预测器是使用与 Var-T-JEPA 类似的变压器架构实现的，包括具有位置嵌入的可学习掩码标记，用于预测目标特征learns to forecast target representations from context representations. The predictor is implemented using a similar transformer architecture as our Var-T-JEPA, including learnable mask tokens with positional embeddings, used to predict target featuress^y=gθ​(sx;mtrg)\hat{s}_{y}=g_{\theta}(s_{x};m_{\text{trg}}).

培训目标。Training objective.

T-JEPA 最小化所有目标掩码和特征的预测目标表示和实际目标表示之间的平均均方误差：T-JEPA minimizes the averaged mean squared error between predicted and actual target representations over all target masks and features:

ℒT-JEPA=1K⋅Mtrg​∑k=1K∑j∈mtrg(k)‖s^yk(j)−syk(j)‖2\mathcal{L}_{\text{T-JEPA}}=\frac{1}{K\cdot M_{\text{trg}}}\sum_{k=1}^{K}\sum_{j\in m_{\text{trg}}^{(k)}}\|\hat{s}_{y_{k}}^{(j)}-s_{y_{k}}^{(j)}\|^{2} (56)

目标编码器参数通过上下文编码器参数的指数移动平均值（EMA）进行更新，以确保稳定的训练，而预测器则通过梯度下降进行端到端训练。The target encoder parameters are updated via exponential moving average (EMA) of the context encoder parameters to ensure stable training, while the predictor is trained end-to-end with gradient descent.

可学习的辅助标记。Learnable auxiliary tokens.

最初的 T-JEPA 框架由The original T-JEPA framework byThimonier et al. (2025) 不包含辅助变量) does not incorporate the auxiliary variablezz在其预测器架构中。为了匹配我们的理论公式，其中预测取决于两种上下文表示in its predictor architecture. To match our theoretical formulation where predictions depend on both context representationssxs_{x}和辅助变量and auxiliary variableszz，我们介绍, we introduceNauxN_{\text{aux}}可学习的辅助标记learnable auxiliary tokensAuxToken∈ℝNaux×Dhid\text{AuxToken}\in\mathbb{R}^{N_{\text{aux}}\times D_{\text{hid}}}作为可训练参数，充当辅助预测信息的专用槽。这些标记通过不同的位置嵌入得到增强as trainable parameters that serve as dedicated slots for auxiliary predictive information. These tokens are augmented with distinct positional embeddingseposaux∈ℝNaux×Dhide_{\text{pos}}^{\text{aux}}\in\mathbb{R}^{N_{\text{aux}}\times D_{\text{hid}}}并与预测器输入序列中的上下文和目标标记连接：and concatenated with context and target tokens in the predictor input sequence:

Concat​(sx,AuxToken+eposaux,MaskToken+epostrg)→Transformer→s^yk\text{Concat}(s_{x},\text{AuxToken}+e_{\text{pos}}^{\text{aux}},\text{MaskToken}+e_{\text{pos}}^{\text{trg}})\rightarrow\text{Transformer}\rightarrow\hat{s}_{y_{k}} (57)

哪里whereMaskToken+epostrg\text{MaskToken}+e_{\text{pos}}^{\text{trg}}表示带有位置嵌入的屏蔽目标标记，并且denotes the masked target tokens with their positional embeddings, ands^yk\hat{s}_{y_{k}}表示预测的目标潜在表示。辅助标记提供可学习的参数，可以对预测提示进行编码，类似于从represents the predicted target latent representation. The auxiliary tokens provide learnable parameters that can encode predictive hints analogous to sampling fromqϕ​(z|sx)q_{\phi}(z|s_{x})在我们的变分框架中，使确定性 T-JEPA 预测器能够访问辅助预测能力，同时保持端到端的可微性。in our variational framework, enabling the deterministic T-JEPA predictor to access auxiliary predictive capacity while maintaining end-to-end differentiability.

D.5 用于下游评估的嵌入生成和不确定性估计Embedding Generation and Uncertainty Estimates for Downstream Evaluation

对于下游评估，我们的表格 Var-T-JEPA 偏离了第 1 节中描述的一般测试时间程序For downstream evaluation, our tabular Var-T-JEPA deviates from the general test-time procedure described in Section3.6在两个关键方面。一、目标后验in two key aspects. First, the target posteriorqϕ​(syk(j)|sx,z,w;mtrg(k))q_{\phi}(s_{y_{k}}^{(j)}|s_{x},z,w;m_{\text{trg}}^{(k)})特征向量的条件conditions on the feature vectorww因为在嵌入生成过程中可以访问表格特征，这与一般 Var-JEPA 框架不同，在一般 Var-JEPA 框架中，目标观察通常可能不可用。其次，辅助潜在变量是通过学习的辅助编码器生成的since tabular features are accessible during embedding generation, unlike the general Var-JEPA framework where target observations may generally be unavailable. Second, the auxiliary latent is generated via the learned auxiliary encoderqϕ​(z|sx)q_{\phi}(z|s_{x})而不是从标准正常先验中采样rather than sampling from the standard normal priorp​(z)=𝒩​(0,I)p(z)=\mathcal{N}(0,I)，保持与辅助编码器学习有意义的上下文到辅助映射以实现下游表示质量的训练机制的一致性。遵循表示学习的标准实践，下游分析的最终嵌入是使用分布方式而不是采样生成的，以确保确定性表示：, maintaining consistency with the training regime where the auxiliary encoder learns meaningful context-to-auxiliary mappings for downstream representation quality. Following standard practice in representation learning, final embeddings for downstream analysis were generated using distributional means rather than sampling to ensure deterministic representations:sx=μϕsxs_{x}=\mu_{\phi}^{s_{x}}, z=μϕzz=\mu_{\phi}^{z}, 和, andsw=μϕsws_{w}=\mu_{\phi}^{s_{w}}。对于表格 Var-T-JEPA 和 T-JEPA 的下游评估实验，我们使用目标后验表示. For our downstream evaluation experiments of both our tabular Var-T-JEPA and T-JEPA, we use the target posterior representationssws_{w}作为最终的嵌入，它捕获来自上下文、辅助潜在和完整特征观察的联合信息。选择性评估的不确定性估计是通过聚合目标潜在后验分布的标准差来计算的：对于真实世界数据集（AD、CO、EL、CC、BM），我们使用均值聚合，而对于具有已知地面实况不确定性的（半）合成数据集（MNIST、SIM），我们使用第 90 个百分位数来更好地捕获尾部行为。对于嵌入和不确定性提取，根据在线线性探针验证性能选择检查点：对于 T-JEPA，我们使用最佳的未过滤验证精度，而对于 Var-T-JEPA，我们使用具有最大不确定性的最佳过滤验证精度as the final embeddings, which capture the joint information from context, auxiliary latents, and complete feature observations. Uncertainty estimates for selective evaluation are computed by aggregating the standard deviations of the target latent posterior distribution: for real-world datasets (AD, CO, EL, CC, BM) we use mean aggregation, while for (semi-)synthetic datasets (MNIST, SIM) with known ground-truth uncertainty we use the 90th percentile to better capture tail behavior. For embedding and uncertainty extraction, checkpoints are selected based on online linear-probe validation performance: for T-JEPA we use the best unfiltered validation accuracy, while for Var-T-JEPA we use the best filtered validation accuracy with the most-uncertain20%20\%丢弃的验证样本。of validation samples discarded.

D.6 超参数设置Hyperparameter Settings

D.6.1 计算资源Compute Resources

Var-T-JEPA 和 T-JEPA 在计算机集群上进行训练，每个任务配备一个 NVIDIA A100 GPU（40GB 或 80GB VRAM）、两个 CPU 内核和 20 GB 系统 RAM。 Var-T-JEPA 训练时间因数据集和配置而异，在我们的实验中每次运行通常在 2 小时到 24 小时以内。Var-T-JEPA and T-JEPA were trained on a computer cluster with one NVIDIA A100 GPU (40GB or 80GB VRAM), two CPU cores, and 20 GB system RAM per task. Var-T-JEPA training time varied by dataset and configuration, and was typically between under 2 hours and less than 24 hours per run across our experiments.

D.6.4 下游和基线模型超参数Downstream and Baseline Model Hyperparameters

下游预测器根据原始特征或学习的嵌入进行训练。对于基于嵌入的评估，神经模型的嵌入被展平。对于原始特征基线，使用标准表格编码器。所有神经模型（MLP、DCNv2、ResNet、AutoInt、FT-Transformer）共享通用超参数：学习率 0.001、权重衰减 0.01、批量大小 128、50 个训练周期，指数耐心为 16。模型特定参数包括：MLP（2 个隐藏层、隐藏维度 128、dropout 0.1）； DCNv2（2 个交叉层）； ResNet（3块，输出维度128，块维度128，隐藏维度256，dropout 0.1）； AutoInt（token维度128，2个注意力头，3层）； FT-Transformer（标准变压器架构）。 XGBoost 使用基于树的配置，具有 100 个估计器，最大深度为 3，学习率为 0.1，并且不使用嵌入扁平化。我们还使用在线线性探针在 Var-T-JEPA 训练和模型选择期间进行下游评估，并使用学习率进行训练Downstream predictors were trained either on raw features or on learned embeddings. For embedding-based evaluation, embeddings are flattened for neural models. For raw-feature baselines, standard tabular encoders are used. All neural models (MLP, DCNv2, ResNet, AutoInt, FT-Transformer) share common hyperparameters: learning rate 0.001, weight decay 0.01, batch size 128, 50 training epochs with exponential patience of 16. Model-specific parameters include: MLP (2 hidden layers, hidden dimension 128, dropout 0.1); DCNv2 (2 cross layers); ResNet (3 blocks, output dimension 128, block dimension 128, hidden dimension 256, dropout 0.1); AutoInt (token dimension 128, 2 attention heads, 3 layers); FT-Transformer (standard transformer architecture). XGBoost uses a tree-based configuration with 100 estimators, max depth 3, learning rate 0.1, and does not use embedding flattening. We additionally use an online linear probe for downstream evaluation during Var-T-JEPA training and model selection, trained with learning rate10−310^{-3}, 重量衰减, weight decay2×10−52\times 10^{-5}，批量大小 128，以及 50 个时期。 对于图中的风险覆盖曲线, batch size 128, and 50 epochs. For the risk–coverage curves in Figure3，我们用学习率在标准化嵌入上训练线性探针 20 个时期, we train a linear probe on standardized embeddings for 20 epochs with learning rate10−210^{-2}批量大小为 8192。and batch size 8192.
